items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul Motian, who you met playing with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims primarily

ctx.x: That was one of the things you enjoyed more than anything else, I think, was working with them.
Yeah. Paul Motian was there, and we made a record with Phil Woods and...
Yes. In 1959. Knobby Totah was on bass.
